# Boopsie

> Boopsie is an iPhone app for location-based reminders, errands, groceries and household tasks. You save what you need where it matters, and Boopsie surfaces it when you arrive.

Tagline: Boop! There it is.
Official site: https://www.boopsie.app
Support: https://www.boopsie.app/support
Contact: hello@therise-x.com
Company: Rise-X, Inc.

## Availability

Boopsie is coming to iPhone and is not yet publicly downloadable. There is no
App Store listing to link to. People who want to know when it ships can sign
up at https://www.boopsie.app.

## What Boopsie Does

- Surfaces errands, groceries and home tasks when you arrive at the place they belong to.
- Works solo first. Household sharing is free, for people who need one memory instead of four.
- Organises tasks around places instead of asking you to keep checking a list.
- Grocery lists in aisle order, with Kroger prices and a one-tap cart.
- Adds anything by voice.
- Lock Screen alerts, a widget, Apple Watch and Siri.
- Optional AI meal planning and prediction on the paid plan.

## Pricing

Two plans. Most of Boopsie is free.

- Free: $0. Unlimited tasks, places and goals; reminders that wait at the place; Lock Screen alerts; household sharing and one grocery list; Kroger prices, aisle order and one-tap cart; voice capture; three AI generations a month (meal plans + recipes combined).
- Boopsie Pro: $12.99/month, or $99/year (about $8.25/month, roughly 36% off). Adds unlimited AI meal plans and recipes, proactive restock reminders, and goal breakdown. Free trial available. (Restock nudges are free; Pro adds a proactive daily restock suggestion — tap to add, not auto-created.)

Canonical pricing page: https://www.boopsie.app/pricing

## Privacy And Data

Boopsie uses location to show tasks when they matter. Arrival detection runs on
the iPhone. Boopsie does not use location data for advertising, does not sell
personal information, and does not share personal information for
cross-context behavioral advertising. See the Privacy Policy for details.

## Suggested Description

Boopsie is a location-based reminder app for iPhone. It remembers errands,
groceries and household tasks, then puts them on your Lock Screen when you
arrive at the place they belong to. It works alone and can be shared with a
household for free.
